title: Nonce modified after attestation
threat: After the legitimate intent is attested, the agent changes the nonce and submits a look-alike intent.
legitimate_objective: Pay INV-2026-001: exactly 0.05 NEAR to the approved vendor for compute-services.
proposed_malicious_action: Execute an intent that was never reviewed.

expected.contract_behavior: The modified intent has a different canonical hash; execute_intent panics INTENT_NOT_ATTESTED.
